Name: Central Station
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
[b]Central Station[/b] lets you travel to other mods' destinations by boat, bus, or train. You can also get a ticket to the Central Station to change line, visit the gift shop, and more.

Mod authors can add custom destinations with optional ticket prices, add ticket machines to their locations, and extend the Central Station location with their own content like tourists and bookshelf messages.

[color=#6aa84f][b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b][/color]


[b][size=6]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Buy a ticket[/b][/size]
You can take the boat, bus, or train by using the ticket machines in relevant locations. (You can take the bus to Central Station even if you haven't unlocked the desert bus yet.)

[img]https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/raw/develop/CentralStation/docs/screenshots/train-station.png[/img]

[size=5][b]Visit Central Station[/b][/size]
You can get a free ticket to Central Station from any ticket machine.

From there, you can...
[list]
[*]get a ticket to any boat, bus, and train destination;[/*]
[*]take a break in the food court;[/*]
[*]visit the gift shop;[/*]
[*]talk to other tourists;[/*]
[*]browse the bookshelves;[/*]
[*]buy custom travel decor, which you can use to decorate your farmhouse or other locations;[/*]
[*][s]wonder who runs the mysterious central station;[/s][/*]
[*]and more.[/*]
[/list]
The Central Station can also include custom content from other mods (like tourists and bookshelf messages). So the more mods you have that use Central Station, the more you can see in the Central Station!


[b][size=5]For mod authors[/size][/b]
See the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/develop/CentralStation/docs/author-guide.md]mod author guide[/url] for more info!


[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no permanent changes to your save.

If you remove the mod after buying Central Station's travel decor items, they'll safely turn into error items until you trash them or re-add the mod.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.

If you have the older Bus Locations or Train Station mods, their stops will appear in the Central Station menu too.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I convert old content packs to Central Station?[/b][/size]
Yep! If you have old Bus Locations or Train Station content packs, you can convert them to work with Central Station directly.

[list]
[*]If you're a player: see [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/develop/CentralStation/docs/README.md#reassign-old-content-packs][i]reassign old content packs[/i][/url].[/*]
[*]If you're a mod author: see the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/develop/CentralStation/docs/author-guide.md]mod author guide[/url] to replace the old content pack with a standard Content Patcher edit.[/*]
[/list][/quote]
